# QS-CFW-9335-36 — Quality specification - gear blank CFW-9335-36 (8620)

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-9335-36

## Scope
This document specifies the quality requirements, inspection criteria, and nonconformance handling for gear blank CFW-9335-36 (8620) produced at Plant P3. It applies to finished forgings presented for heat treatment and final inspection prior to release to manufacturing.

## Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for gear blank CFW-9335-36 (CFW-9335-36) is 36-41 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for gear blank CFW-9335-36 (CFW-9335-36) is ±0.09 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for gear blank CFW-9335-36 (CFW-9335-36) is 107.9 kg. |

Notes: Material process, chemistry, and drawing geometry are controlled by associated manufacturing documents and process orders. Verify parts are properly identified with the part number prior to inspection.

## Inspection method
- Hardness: Perform hardness testing per plant standard portable or bench-scale Rockwell tester calibrated to plant calibration procedure. Record readings and verify compliance with The hardness range for gear blank CFW-9335-36 (CFW-9335-36) is 36-41 HRC. Test locations shall be free of surface scale or distortion that could affect the reading.
- Bore tolerance: Measure bore diameter using calibrated bore gauge or inside micrometer. Report measured size and confirm compliance with The bore diameter tolerance for gear blank CFW-9335-36 (CFW-9335-36) is ±0.09 mm.
- Weight: Verify part weight on calibrated scale and confirm it does not exceed The maximum forging weight for gear blank CFW-9335-36 (CFW-9335-36) is 107.9 kg.

Document all inspection results on the part inspection record and attach to the lot paperwork.

## Nonconformance handling
Parts failing any requirement shall be segregated, tagged, and documented. Initiate disposition using the plant nonconformance process and complete corrective action prior to release. Rework or repair must restore the part to meet the documented requirements; otherwise the part shall be rejected.
